description: Search current residential, rural and commercial real-estate listings for sale or rent in Portugal. Use this whenever the user wants to find, compare or explore properties — by location, budget, typology, property type, condition or energy rating. Returns price, price per m², typology, areas, neighbourhood, source and a citable listing URL, plus `total`: the exact number of listings matching the filters, which makes this tool usable to answer 'how many' questions. Listings are aggregated from portals and agency sites and refreshed continuously; each result carries the date it was last checked at the source. Sources publish uneven detail: filtering on an attribute silently excludes listings that omit it, so prefer the broadest filters that answer the question and report `total` as a floor, not a census.

condition.description: State of repair, or an array of states. Only matches listings whose source published it.

energyClass.description: Energy certificate class. Selects the whole band the class belongs to: A+/A, B/B-, C, or D-and-below. Only matches listings that carry a certificate.

location.description: Location: district, municipality, neighbourhood, town or postal-code prefix (e.g. Lisbon, Cascais, Chiado, 2750). Not a free-text keyword search — words that are not places (e.g. 'sea view') will not match.

minArea.description: Minimum floor area in m². Matches either the gross or the useful area, whichever the source published. Only matches listings that published an area.

minBathrooms.description: Minimum number of bathrooms. Only matches listings whose source published a bathroom count.

operation.description: buy = for sale, rent = to let. Defaults to buy; a listing is one or the other, so call twice to cover both.

page.description: 1-based page number. Use it with `total` to walk through a large result set.

priceMax.description: Maximum price, in the market currency. Note: listings advertised 'price on request' have no price and are excluded by either price bound.

priceMin.description: Minimum price, in the market currency.

propertyType.description: Property type, or an array of types. Omit to search all types. `farm` covers rural estates (quintas); `building` is a whole apartment block.

sort.description: Result order. Default `recent` (most recently published first).

typology.description: Normalised typology code (T0, T1, T2, T3…), where the number is the count of bedrooms. Used in every market, including the German and Polish ones. Matched exactly; pass an array to match several. The buckets `T0–T1` and `T4+` are also accepted.

name: search_properties

hasMore.description: true when further pages are available.

market.description: ISO country code of this market.

operation.description: The operation actually searched (comprar = for sale, arrendar = to let).

features.description: Amenities as published by the source (Portuguese labels).

firstSeen.description: ISO 8601 date the listing was first published.

landArea.description: Plot area in m²; relevant for houses, land and farms.

lastSeen.description: ISO 8601 date we last confirmed the listing at the source.

neighbourhood.description: Neighbourhood, when the source located the listing precisely enough.

operation.description: comprar = for sale, arrendar = to let.

price.description: null means the source does not publish a price (on request).

priceLabel.description: Formatted price for display; empty when price is null.

propertyType.description: Property type; the same token accepted by the propertyType filter.

slug.description: Stable identifier; use it in get_property_detail.

source.description: Portal or agency site the listing came from; null when published directly with us.

sourceUrl.description: Original listing URL at the source. Cite this alongside url.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 date the record last changed on our side.

url.description: Canonical listing page on this market's domain.

total.description: Exact number of listings in this market matching the filters, across all pages.
